# How Big Is the AntiScam Dataset? Scale, Composition, and Annotation Coverage

## Introduction

The AntiScam dataset is a human–human anti-scam dialog corpus that was created to support research on non-collaborative dialog systems, specifically in connection with the paper *End-to-End Trainable Non-Collaborative Dialog System* ([Document 2](document_2.txt)). When researchers ask how "big" a dataset such as AntiScam is, the question is not answered by a single number. Dataset size can be measured through the total number of dialogs, the number of turns and utterances per conversation, the volume of annotated sentences, the number of annotators involved, and the number of participants who produced the data.
